<subject>Re: Corporate Secretary Replacement</subject>
<body>
We'll miss you too. Glad we had your support while it lasted. See you at the Board meeting.

Elliot
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Archer, Kathryn 
Sent: Thursday, 07 November 2024 7:25 PM
To: Cole, Elliot; Leonard, Oliver
Subject: Corporate Secretary Replacement

As you all likely know, I will officially retire on 31 December 2024; therefore, the meeting on 11 November will be my last and a fitting moment to elect my successor. Thank you for allowing me to remain as your corporate secretary after stepping down from that role at [COMPANY]. I don’t think I could have quit “cold turkey,” and I’ve cherished my time at Halcyon due to my respect for the directors and most of management. (I’ll reserve comment on certain former colleagues.) I’ve especially enjoyed the renewed energy since Elliot took the lead — morale and performance both reflect it. I’ve long admired [ORG_2] and valued working with Oliver Leonard. It is my sincere hope — and formal recommendation — that Oliver succeed me. He has repeatedly proven capable; in truth, he’s already been performing the role, aside from formally recording minutes, which he’s covered for me on multiple occasions. He is a person of integrity, loyalty, and dedication, and I know the Board respects him. I hope you both agree.  
I’ll miss you all. Valerie, I’d love to meet you and Oliver for lunch anytime. I’ll also remain available should you need advice or support.  
Thank you once more.  
Warm regards,  
Kathryn Archer
</quoted>
